# Cryo capability contract

<!-- Generated by `python -m cryo.capabilities.generate_docs`; do not edit. -->

Manifest schema: `1.1.0`  
Canonical source: `cryo.capabilities.manifest`

This document states what Cryo can execute today. A configured connection does not imply
operation support: conditional, fallback-only, experimental, and blocked paths are explicit.

## Maturity

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **GA** | Supported for production use and protected by executable contracts. |
| **BETA** | Operational but still gathering production proof or narrowing limitations. |
| **EXPERIMENTAL** | Opt-in surface without a production-readiness claim. |
| **BLOCKED** | Unavailable because the required engine primitive does not exist. |

## Engine status

| Engine | Maturity | Executes work | Contract | Limitations | Owner | Evidence |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Trino (`trino`) | **GA** | Yes | Direct Iceberg maintenance through Trino SQL procedures. | No native rewrite_position_delete_files procedure.<br>convert_deletes uses OPTIMIZE and cannot apply Spark delete-threshold options. | `engines/trino` | [code: `_render_operation`](../cryo/engines/trino/sql.py)<br>[test: `test_trino_render_golden_operation_sql_and_session_setup`](../tests/test_trino_sql_golden.py) |
| Spark / EMR (`spark_emr`) | **GA** | Yes | Full maintenance surface through Iceberg Spark procedures. | Execution requires a working Spark or Spark-on-Kubernetes destination. | `engines/spark` | [code: `_render_operation`](../cryo/engines/spark/sql.py)<br>[test: `test_spark_render_golden_operation_sql`](../tests/test_spark_sql_golden.py) |
| Native (`native`) | **BETA** | Yes | Go subprocess for low-overhead maintenance with explicit SQL fallbacks. | Native data-file optimization is Go-only and table-shape gated.<br>Manifest, statistics, and delete rewrites require a configured SQL fallback. | `engines/native` | [code: `resolve_native_routing`](../cryo/engines/native/routing.py)<br>[test: `test_resolve_native_routing_cow_includes_optimize`](../tests/test_native_routing.py) |
| Flink (`flink`) | **EXPERIMENTAL** | No | Generates Flink maintenance configuration; Cryo does not submit the job. | execute() reports configuration generation only and performs no external effect. | `engines/flink` | [code: `def execute`](../cryo/engines/flink/engine.py)<br>[test: `test_flink_engine_execute`](../tests/test_flink_engine.py) |

## Drift policy

- Every `EngineType x OperationType` pair must have exactly one matrix cell.
- Runtime routing, the API, the Connections UI, and this document consume the same manifest.
- Evidence paths and symbols are executable contracts, not readiness claims by themselves.
- CI fails when this generated document differs from the canonical manifest.
